turns.q: Can you check the status of my latest order?
turns.replyTail:
ito (INTL) · AI says:
Check My Account > Orders for your latest order, its status, and—once dispatched—the tracking link. Statuses mean: Pending Payment (verification), Processing (being handled), Cancelled (unsuccessful), We’re Packing Your Parcel (preparing), Left Our Warehouse (shipped and trackable), and Delivered (delivered). Track shipped parcels on Skynet, or DHL for Japan, Saudi Arabia, and UAE—mercifully, no detective work required.
